repos.name: lyogavin/airllm
repos.one_liner: A library designed to run massive 70B parameter LLMs on consumer-grade hardware with as little as 4GB of VRAM.
bullets: Utilizes layer-wise inference optimization to drastically reduce memory footprint.
Enables high-performance LLM deployment on edge devices or budget cloud instances.
Supports large-scale model execution without requiring expensive multi-GPU clusters.
Ideal for local AI agent development and cost-effective inference pipelines.

repos.name: richhardvano/SlotDrift
repos.description: Slot continuity and fork analysis for captured Solana slot records - gaps, skips, duplicate slots and orphaned branches, with an independent Rust engine.
repos.one_liner: A specialized analysis tool for Solana blockchain slot continuity, fork detection, and network performance auditing.
bullets: Features a high-performance Rust engine for processing captured blockchain slot records.
Identifies critical network anomalies including gaps, skips, and orphaned branches.
Provides essential data for quant traders and infrastructure providers to monitor chain health.
Enables precise forensic analysis of Solana ledger integrity and consensus performance.

repos.name: ARahim3/DigUp
repos.description: Search your Mac by what's in your files: photos, PDFs, recordings, videos and code. On-device, built on Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.
repos.one_liner: A privacy-focused, on-device semantic search engine for macOS using Google DeepMind's EmbeddingGemma 2.
bullets: Leverages local embedding models to index photos, PDFs, videos, and codebases.
Operates entirely on-device, ensuring sensitive financial or personal data never leaves the machine.
Provides natural language search capabilities for local file systems.
Serves as a powerful local infrastructure tool for knowledge management and document retrieval.

repos.name: StoopwenpueNq/QuorumForge
repos.description: Multi-agent evidence adjudication engine - normalize claims, weigh support and contradiction, and render deterministic verdicts, with a Rust engine and a TypeScript viewer.
repos.one_liner: A multi-agent adjudication engine designed to normalize conflicting claims and generate deterministic verdicts.
bullets: Combines a robust Rust-based logic engine with a TypeScript-based visualization layer.
Implements structured evidence weighting to resolve contradictions between multiple AI agents.
Useful for automated compliance, audit trails, and complex decision-making workflows.
Provides a framework for verifiable and transparent agentic reasoning.

repos.name: Parcha-ai/agentrun
repos.one_liner: A domain-specific language (DSL) designed to define, orchestrate, and manage complex agentic workflows.
bullets: Provides a structured syntax for defining multi-step agent interactions and state management.
Simplifies the orchestration of complex tasks in autonomous agent systems.
Focuses on reliability and repeatability in agent-based automation.
Targeted at developers building scalable infrastructure for agentic applications.
